Stay tuned for the latest updates on the Bohemia Interactive Studio Forums:

----
Tom Larkin, one of the Larkin brothers has been digging in his father's past.
In a recent attic cleanup Tom found and unsend letter, which he is determined to deliver.
'''Wil Tom find the people who knew his father in his youth?
and who is that mysterious girl from the postcard?'''
Follow Tom in his travel to the Aegean where he'll spend his adventurous vacation on Altis and Stratis.
----
